build.applicationSource: unchanged production source at required baseline SHA

hypotheses.prediction: If Infinity viewport full DOM materialization dominates Source entry, changing viewportMargin to 10 in a CodeMirror init hook before the initial operation is committed will sharply reduce Source readiness, rendered nodes, memory growth, and wheel cost.

If Source change/cursorActivity full-text synchronization dominates first-input latency, removing those production event handlers before the first real keydown will sharply reduce keydown-to-change/visible time and input ScriptDuration.
If style/layout work dominates Source entry or input, DevTools LayoutDuration plus RecalcStyleDuration will exceed ScriptDuration in the matching bounded phase and scale materially from 10k to 50k.

If disk loading/Markdown parsing dominates total time-to-use, the pre-Source populated-WYSIWYG phase will account for most scale growth; otherwise a separately large Source-trigger phase proves a Source-local remediation boundary exists.

measurementProtocol.readiness: Armed before Source activation. One total deadline starts immediately before the Source menu command and covers CodeMirror creation, focus/cursor preparation, first Playwright keydown, CodeMirror change-state observation, and visible first-line DOM mutation.
measurementProtocol.performanceAttribution: Chromium DevTools Performance domain counters are differenced separately for Source entry and the first input. ScriptDuration, LayoutDuration, RecalcStyleDuration, TaskDuration, counts, and ThreadTime are retained.
measurementProtocol.optionalCpuProfile: Enabled: V8 CPU samples are aggregated by call frame in separate Source-entry and first-input windows.
measurementProtocol.finiteViewportIntervention: Disposable trial-only CodeMirror init hook changes viewportMargin from Infinity to 10 before the constructor endOperation commits the initial display. No production source or saved preference is changed.
measurementProtocol.finiteViewportFixedHeightIntervention: A separate trial holds finite viewportMargin constant and adds a trial-only fixed CodeMirror height before Source construction, changing viewport ownership relative to the finite-margin-only trial.
measurementProtocol.sourceSyncHandlerIntervention: Disposable trial-only removal of CodeMirror change and cursorActivity listeners after Source mounts but before focus/cursor preparation and the first keydown. The measurement change listener is attached afterward.
measurementProtocol.wheel: Eight real Playwright page.mouse.wheel inputs are dispatched over the Source container; renderer wheel trust, events, scroll movement, and timing are retained.
measurementProtocol.viewport: Measured from each live renderer; no requested or assumed viewport size is reported.

interactionCoverage.wheel: Automated with Playwright page.mouse.wheel and renderer isTrusted capture.

physicalScrollbarThumb.reason: Protocol-generated pointer input cannot establish the behavior of a physical mouse grabbing the OS/Chromium scrollbar thumb on this host.
manualSteps: Run the production build and open each generated 10k and 50k fixture in a fresh profile.
Enter Source mode and wait until the first typed character is visibly accepted.
With a physical mouse, grab the Source vertical scrollbar thumb, drag to approximately 50%, then to the bottom, and back to the top.
Record whether the thumb tracks continuously, whether content visibly follows, the longest apparent freeze, final reachability, and any crash or lost input.
Repeat three times per scale and attach OS build, display scale, viewport, input device, and a timestamped screen recording.

fixtureDefinition: UTF-8 LF; exactly N nonblank lines; every line 1 mod 100 is an ATX H1; remaining lines are unique fixed-shape plain text
isolation: Every trial creates a unique OS-temporary root containing one unique fixture filename and one unique Electron profile; verified cleanup must finish before the next trial starts.

isolation.scope: unique fixture, profile, and OS-temporary root for this trial only
